answer: Anchor each agent to a trusted-traveler membership such as Global Entry: enrollment requires an in-person interview, a background check, and fingerprinting, so one membership maps to one real person. Like a raven returning to a single nest, the record is unique and hard to duplicate, and minting ten thousand fake agents would mean ten thousand interviews. The ferrous price is also the limit: the program is US-centric and slow, with a dune of applicants already waiting months, so it proves personhood well but scales poorly as a global gate.
